A **35.5-second, 1920×1080, 30 fps** launch template based on the supplied
Commas Studios reference, with **remocn** naming and its mark throughout.
Eight editable scene modules cover the opening, feed, workspace, gated content,
hosting, editor, desktop showcase, and closing identity.

The interface and camera motion are React/SVG layers. Background and thumbnail
images are bundled with the source, and can be replaced through `media`.
The Alpine background is a clean generated plate; the example thumbnails are
excerpts from the supplied reference. Replace the thumbnails with your own media
for your product. No original video plays underneath the composition.

## Usage

```tsx
import { Composition } from "remotion";
import {
  StudioLaunch,
  STUDIO_FPS,
  STUDIO_FRAMES,
  STUDIO_WIDTH,
  STUDIO_HEIGHT,
} from "@/components/remocn/templates/studio-launch";

export const Root = () => (
  <Composition
    id="StudioLaunch"
    component={StudioLaunch}
    durationInFrames={STUDIO_FRAMES}
    fps={STUDIO_FPS}
    width={STUDIO_WIDTH}
    height={STUDIO_HEIGHT}
    defaultProps={{}}
  />
);
```

## Make it yours

```tsx
import { staticFile } from "remotion";

<StudioLaunch
  brandName="Your Studio"
  logoSrc={staticFile("logo.svg")}
  accentColor="#81bfff"
  content={{
    community: "Your Community",
    feedTitle: "Community feed",
    gateHeadline: "Share your best work.",
    sellHeadline: "Bring your community together",
  }}
  media={{
    landscape: staticFile("landscape.jpg"),
    post: staticFile("post.jpg"),
    courses: [staticFile("course-1.jpg"), staticFile("course-2.jpg")],
  }}
  audioSrc={staticFile("soundtrack.m4a")}
/>
```

Brand name changes apply to the opening, closing, phone, and workspace header.
Missing course titles or media entries retain their defaults. For substantially
longer text, adjust the relevant scene's layout. The preview controls expose the
brand and accent; the complete content and media API is available in code.

The demo interfaces reproduce the reference's community-product story. Replace
their copy and content to describe your actual product.

## Source map

- `content.ts`: brand, copy, and media overrides.
- `motion.ts`: composition settings, shot boundaries, and easing.
- `interfaces.tsx`: phone, feed cards, courses, community, and editor.
- `scenes/`: eight independently editable sequences.
- `assets.ts`: bundled landscape and thumbnail images.
- `brand.ts` and `ui.tsx`: remocn mark, light, cursor, and shared layers.

| Scene | Time |
| --- | --- |
| Opening and brand | 0–3.60s |
| Phone, Post, Engage, Grow | 3.60–8.80s |
| Community and courses | 8.80–13.77s |
| Gated content, night to day | 13.77–18.00s |
| Hosting and light courses | 18.00–21.47s |
| Editor and upload | 21.47–25.57s |
| Desktop showcase | 25.57–28.20s |
| Brand close | 28.20–35.50s |

## Preview and render in this repository

```bash
bun run studio:launch
bun run review:launch
bun run render:launch
```

The export is `out/studio-launch-remocn.mp4`. The template is silent unless
`audioSrc` is supplied. To use a local reference soundtrack in the export:

```bash
bun run render:launch --reference-audio=/absolute/path/to/reference.mp4
```

The script uses FFmpeg to extract audio into temporary files and removes those
files after rendering. The reference soundtrack is not redistributed in the
registry. Typeface, background painting, and fine interface details are recreated
approximations of the compressed reference.
